CustomField.description: Puts this project on the home page as a case study card and sets its place, lowest first. The home page shows at most three cards and reads only this field to choose them, never Is Featured, so a home card never changes the API or the cover letters.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: 1, 2 or 3 to show this project as a home page case study in that place. Leave blank to keep it off the home page.
CustomField.label: Home Sort
